item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect Guangdong at first tomorrow. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will develop gradually, and bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The trough of low pressure is expected to depart slightly from the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, but there will still be showers over the coastal areas.

Date/Month: 19/05 (Sunday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier with a few squally thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 23 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
